stories.headline: Broadcom offers Anthropic $42 billion financing
stories.summary: Broadcom agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42 billion toward a $125.2 billion TPU-compute lease. Anthropic disclosed potential conflicts from relying on the same company as hardware supplier and financier.

stories.headline: AI spending lifts global factory activity
stories.summary: September factory surveys showed expansion across much of Europe and Asia, partly driven by AI and semiconductor demand. Growth was uneven, while high energy costs and rising interest rates cloud the outlook.

stories.headline: Second judge blocks Trump’s $100,000 H-1B fee
stories.summary: A federal judge blocked the fee after finding that agencies bypassed required rulemaking. The injunction applies while litigation proceeds; a separate proposed permanent fee could face another challenge.

stories.headline: US sees near-term Taiwan invasion as unlikely
stories.summary: US officials told Reuters that a Chinese invasion before 2028 appears increasingly unlikely, citing military-readiness delays and Taiwan’s 2028 election. The assessment is not a guarantee, and Beijing still reserves the use of force.

stories.headline: China suspends most October fuel exports
stories.summary: Chinese refiners paused fuel exports beyond Hong Kong and Macau while Beijing prioritizes domestic supply. Four sources described the restriction; officials had not said whether exports would resume after the October 7 holiday.
